comments.author: @flapjack7093
comments.text: I understand the frustration with rising prices in the US, but it’s interesting to compare the local purchasing power. Even with inflation, the ratio of wages to food costs in America is still much higher than in developing countries. For example, in other count, basic food prices are reaching global standards, but the local minimum wage is so low that people have to struggle significantly more just to afford the exact same basket of groceries.
